name: Tartarus ~Naraku no Shounen-tachi
original_name: タルタロス～奈落の少年たち
source:
Boys are taken away from real world to the world "Tartarus" where they are trained with the use of suspicious magical medicine.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-june-2007-koisuru-otome-to.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
男孩们被从现实世界带到“塔尔塔洛斯”世界，在那里他们接受使用可疑魔法药物的训练。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-june-2007-koisuru-otome-to.html]vndbreview[/url]]
